name: Asahi D. Lutwidge
original_name: 朝日・D・ルートウィッジ
source:
[url=/c11598]Yayoi's[/url] younger sister.

Even though her hair and stuff obviously stand out, she is not showy. She is a comforting small animal. Always smiling, and none of her classmates have ever seen her get seriously angry. 

She doesn’t mind [url=/c11601]Tooru’s[/url] more troublesome aspects, so she’s another one of his few friends. When she and [url=/c17214]Tetsuya[/url] are together they suddenly form their own world, so that’s a pain. 

In a sappy couple sort of way.

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616215827/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1064]Mangagamer[/url]]
